title: Formation and onboarding forms: the Email box is now the client's portal login, with a big red warning
text: In the company formation form, and in the form for a client who already has a company, the Email box used to be a normal box the client could type over. A different email typed there changed only the email in the CRM, not the email the client logs in with, so the two drifted apart. Now the box shows the email the client really logs in with and cannot be typed over. Under it is a big red block, "Read well before proceeding.", saying this is the email used to log in to the client portal and the official email of the account, with an "I read it" tick. The Next button stays grey until the tick is ticked, and pressing it anyway lights up the red block. A client who already has a company is also told to keep using the same email for the new company, because one login lets them switch between their companies from the top bar. Submitting the form no longer changes the contact's email. To use a different email, the client is told to message us in chat; a self-service change with a code comes later.
points: Open the formation form as a client: the Email box shows their login email, locked, with the red block under it
Press Next without ticking "I read it": the block lights up and Next stays grey; tick it and Next turns blue
Open the form as a client who already has a company: the red block also has the paragraph about keeping the same email
Check the CRM contact after a submit: its email has not changed
